front: Summon your eidolon adjacent to you; it can then take one action. If already manifested, this unmanifests them.
back:
Eidolon appears in an open adjacent space and takes a single action; if already manifested, unmanifest them.
Eidolon must stay within 100 feet of you and can't willingly go farther.
If forced beyond 100 feet, you drop to 0 HP, or the eidolon dies, it unmanifests and you must use this again.
Special: has the trait of your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
